auth.title: Access token required
auth.description: This server has an access token configured (OPENKB_API_TOKEN). Enter the token to continue; it is stored only in this browser.
auth.baseLabel: API address (optional; leave blank to use the current origin)

workbench.title: Desktop Workbench
workbench.detail: OpenKB is starting its local Engine. Your documents and model settings remain on this computer.

starting.title: Starting local Engine
starting.detail: The Desktop Shell is completing its private connection to OpenKB.

ready.title: Local Engine is ready
ready.detail: The Desktop Workbench can now safely load knowledge and begin work.

unavailable.title: Local Engine is unavailable
unavailable.detail: The Engine is not ready yet. Retry when it becomes available.

knowledgeBases.loadErrorTitle: Could not read the active knowledge base
knowledgeBases.emptyTitle: Start with a Desktop Knowledge Base
knowledgeBases.emptyDescription: Create a new SQLite knowledge base or open an existing Desktop Knowledge Base. One Desktop Runtime works with one active knowledge base at a time.
knowledgeBases.createDescription: Choose an empty directory. OpenKB will create its SQLite authority state and raw-source directory there.
knowledgeBases.openDescription: Choose a knowledge-base directory created by OpenKB Desktop. Legacy CLI/Web knowledge bases are not modified.
knowledgeBases.namePlaceholder: Uses the directory name by default
knowledgeBases.importDescription: Enter one local TXT path. OpenKB keeps its raw source once, then builds Document IR, evidence, and local full-text search.
knowledgeBases.importedDocument: {{name}} is ready for retrieval with {{evidence}} evidence blocks.
knowledgeBases.readyDescription: This knowledge base is bound to this Desktop Runtime. Future imports, answers, and knowledge editing will happen here safely.
